name: file-translator-mcp
description: CAD file format translator. Converts between STL, STEP, IGES, OBJ, PLY, 3MF, DXF formats with mesh repair and analysis capabilities.

tools.name: convert_file
tools.description: Convert between CAD file formats (STL, STEP, IGES, OBJ, PLY, 3MF, DXF)

tools.name: stl_to_step
tools.description: Convert STL mesh to STEP B-rep with surface reconstruction

tools.name: stl_to_iges
tools.description: Convert STL mesh to IGES format

tools.name: step_to_stl
tools.description: Convert STEP to STL mesh

tools.name: step_to_iges
tools.description: Convert STEP to IGES

tools.name: iges_to_step
tools.description: Convert IGES to STEP

tools.name: iges_to_stl
tools.description: Convert IGES to STL mesh

tools.name: obj_to_stl
tools.description: Convert OBJ to STL

tools.name: obj_to_step
tools.description: Convert OBJ mesh to STEP B-rep

tools.name: ply_to_stl
tools.description: Convert PLY point cloud/mesh to STL

tools.name: batch_convert
tools.description: Convert multiple files to a target format in batch

tools.name: analyze_mesh
tools.description: Analyze mesh properties (triangles, volume, watertight status)

tools.name: detect_format
tools.description: Auto-detect CAD file format from header bytes

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get detailed file information (size, format, encoding)

tools.name: repair_mesh
tools.description: Repair common mesh defects (non-manifold edges, holes, degeneracies)

tools.description: Reduce triangle count while preserving shape

tools.description: Fill holes in non-watertight meshes
